positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Used knowledge of C++ and Python programming languages to advance an automated vehicle research platform in areas related to path planning, vehicle-to-vehicle communication, and vehicle-to-infrastructure communication.
-Contributed to the development of multiple automated data analysis and validation tools, allowing the team to evaluate system performance and effectively target areas of improvement in a precise data-driven manner.
-Performed under the agile development process in software engineering to complete tasks within sprints
-Regularly communicated progress and setbacks that took place during testing, while adhering to the agile principle of delivering value to the customer every sprint.
positions.insights: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Robot Operating System (ROS) · Ubuntu · C++ · Enterprise Architecture · Docker Products · Agile Software Development · Java · GitHub · Unix

positions.title: Computer Science Lab Research Assistant
positions.description:
-Developed action script in Unity
-Implemented subject testing and workshop materials
-Researched and produced scripts regarding SQL Injections,  FTP, and shadow file access.

positions.title: Computer Science Lab Tutor/Monitor
positions.description:
Provided in-class assistance to Computer Science professors

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Researched and explored data visualization software for displaying IP address information
- Utilized the Kibana data visualization tool to display trends and patterns in IP information
- Examined and employed the Flawfinder tool to scan C/C++ source code files to detect risks and security flaws

positions.title: Math Supplemental Instructor
positions.description:
-Tutored incoming freshmen in Precalculus for a seven-week long summer program
-Provided assistance to a Precalculus college professor
-Collaborated with co-workers to plan activities and events for the students
-Scheduled individual meetings with students for supplemental instruction 
-Organized lesson plans in order to effectively summarize lectures
